name: Marcora: Brand Context & Writing
description:
Marcora is the context layer for go-to-market teams. You build a shared source of truth once, your Brand Foundation (voice, positioning, writing style) plus a Reference Library of product docs, persona research, competitive analysis, and messaging, and Marcora makes it available right inside Claude. Every piece of content you generate draws on that context automatically, so output stays on-brand, accurate, and grounded in how your company actually talks.

What you can do from Claude:
- Retrieve brand foundations, writing standards, and reference materials with cited sources
- Generate on-brand content from proven Blueprints or an open canvas
- Spin up coordinated multi-format campaigns (blog, email, in-app) from a single Blueprint
- Organize launches and campaigns into Projects with auto-generated briefs
- Share work as trackable branded links or export to Word
- Package multi-step processes into reusable Workflows

Context Intelligence keeps everything current: Marcora runs freshness checks on web-sourced material, scans for drift as your messaging evolves, and surfaces one-click fixes, so the intelligence behind every deliverable stays current without manual upkeep.

Marcora is built for product marketers and GTM teams at B2B SaaS companies, and extends to sales, customer success, and product. It connects across your stack through 200+ integrations, so the tools where work already lives become context for your content.

A free tier includes context access so you can connect and pull your brand context into Claude today. Paid plans add content generation, integrations, advanced Context Intelligence, and branded shareable links.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Marcora: Brand Context & Writing to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Marcora: Brand Context & Writing to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.marcora.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Marcora: Brand Context & Writing MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marcora: Brand Context & Writing lists 38 MCP tools, including add_context, ask_content_assistant, convert_markdown_to_word_doc, create_blueprint, create_blueprint_draft, create_content, create_context_collection, create_external_share, create_project, create_workflow, finalize_blueprint_draft, and get_blueprint.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Marcora: Brand Context & Writing?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Marcora: Brand Context & Writing in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Marcora: Brand Context & Writing MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marcora: Brand Context & Writing requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Marcora: Brand Context & Writing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marcora: Brand Context & Writing is developed by Marcora. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
